lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Hi! Im Mark what is your name?

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: Hi, i am Ellen what are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: You know, the more dangerous the more money ha-ha-ha.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: One of the aliens stole my jagermeister!

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: You probably know how rare this drink is nowadays

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: Kill that bastard and bring jagermeister back!

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: And what i receive for that?

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: I can give you an access card.

lines.speaker: Mark
lines.text: With it you can open closed doors

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: I killed the alien. Here is your jagermeister.
